source:
@@U03354@@
Surprise! Here we are!
And already in place!
Better not to ask how or where from,
because we don’t have a clue.
Really, all we can say is that we're here.
We figure there's nowhere not worth living;
that it can be cheerful anywhere.
And wherever a chink in a rock appears,
a dwarf is sure to turn up soon.
In pairs, of course, man and wife,
industrious couple, too,
a model pair, to be sure.
translation:
@@U03354@@
惊喜！我们到了！
并且已经就位！
最好不要问如何或从哪里来，
因为我们没有任何线索。
真的，我们只能说我们在这里。
我们认为没有什么地方不值得居住；
任何地方都可以是快乐的。
无论岩石上出现什么缝隙，
矮人肯定很快就会出现。
当然是夫妻，
夫妻俩也很勤劳
可以肯定的是，这是一对模型。
